description: See your photo and caption as a realistic square Instagram post mock.

faqs.a: Upload an image or paste an image URL, type your caption, and the tool renders an Instagram-style square post mock.
No — this is a visual mock only. Screenshot it or copy the caption to use in the Instagram app.
Instagram crops feed photos to square (1:1) by default — the preview uses that crop with object-fit cover.
